highlight.words: Choose a part of Settings here. A dot marks a part that needs you.
Services, Calendars and Send to each have one tab. Select a row, then choose an action below it.
Choose engines in the job row. Set order changes a longer chain. The saved order stays until your press.
Channels, When, Calls and Brief share this pane. In Brief, select a row to show its form below. Return puts focus in the first control.
The Engines tab lists the engines on this desk. Plus opens the model library.
